about_short_description.short_description: Eyewa offers prescription contact lenses, color contact lenses, sunglasses, and eyeglasses.

product.name: Prescription Contact Lenses
product.description: Contact lenses designed to correct vision based on a user's prescription.

product.name: Color Contact Lenses
product.description: Contact lenses that change or enhance the color of the eyes for cosmetic or aesthetic purposes.

product.name: Sunglasses
product.description: Eyewear designed to protect eyes from ultraviolet (UV) rays and reduce glare from sunlight.

product.name: Eyeglasses (Prescription Glasses)
product.description: Glasses with lenses prescribed to correct vision impairments, available in various frame styles and materials.

product.name: Eyewa Care (1-Year Damage Protection Warranty)
product.description: A service providing a one-year warranty covering breakage, scratches, and prescription changes for eyeglasses and prescription sunglasses.

product.name: Eyewa PRO Membership
product.description: A subscription service offering benefits such as buy-one-get-one-free deals on Eyewa-owned brands and damage protection for 12 months.
